Importing Douban marks requires logging into Trakt first, marks will sync to your Trakt watchlist/watched list. Login to Trakt now?

Trakt is an international movie and TV tracking platform, similar to Douban's marking feature. You can record movies and shows you want to watch or have watched, track viewing progress, and get personalized recommendations.

After logging in to Trakt in this app, you can:
• Sync and manage your watchlist/watched list
• Import marks from Douban to Trakt in one tap
• Sync your viewing records across devices
• View watching statistics and recommendations

If you don't have a Trakt account yet, tap the button below to register.
Login to your Douban account below. Your marks will be synced to Trakt automatically.
This page is used to log in to Douban to read your public marks (wishlist/watched). Credentials are used only for this sync and are not uploaded to any third-party server.

• Why login: to read your Douban marks (wishlist, watched, ratings)
• What is stored: only Cookie and userId (for this crawl), NOT your Douban password
• Cookie usage: only for requesting movie.douban.com/people/{userId}/wish|collect pages
• After sync: you can clear Douban credentials anytime in Settings
• Data flow: Douban → App → Trakt, no intermediate servers

Cooldown: Douban has anti-crawl measures. Frequent repeated crawls may get your IP blacklisted. A 7-day cooldown after a full crawl reduces request frequency. During cooldown, incremental sync reuses cloud data without re-crawling; you can force sync at your own risk.

pansou_template: compatible with the PanSou API response format. The resource list is under the data.merged_by_type field, a map keyed by disk type (quark/baidu/aliyun/xunlei/uc/115/magnet) with an array of links as the value; each link has note (name, may be empty), url and datetime fields.

zreso_template: compatible with the ZReso API response format. The resource list is under the data.results field, an array; each element has title (name), datetime/date and links (an array, the first link\'s url and type are used).
custom: custom mode, requires JSONPath expressions (e.g. $.data.results) to parse JSON response yourself.

If API returns JSON: {"data": {"results": [{"title": "Movie Name", "url": "https://...", "type": "quark"}]}}
Config: parseMode = custom listPath = $.data.results namePath = $.title urlPath = $.url diskTypePath = $.type

On the Douban sync-failure item detail page, you can directly write "Want to watch"/"Watched"/"Remove mark" back to Douban.
Switching Wish/Collected persists the new status to the failure list. Removing the mark deletes the failure item (with a second confirmation).

Douban and Trakt statuses may diverge. The check unifies both sides by the rule "Watched takes priority over Want-to-watch": the watched status overrides wishlist, and the side that is watched is written back to the other, so no mark is ever lost. It also cleans up legacy items that are both in Want-to-watch and Watched on Trakt (leftover from old data), automatically removing their Want-to-watch mark. Q: What do the numbers above mean?\nA: They show your total watched count (movies + shows), this month\'s watched count, and this year\'s watched count, based on your Trakt history.
Q: What is the watching heatmap?\nA: Similar to GitHub\'s contribution graph, each square represents one day. The darker the color, the more you watched that day. It covers the past year.
Q: What is the genre distribution pie chart?\nA: It shows the proportion of each genre in your watched history. Tap a slice to see the exact count and percentage.
Q: What is the top genres ranking?\nA: Your most-watched genres ranked by count. The top three are marked with gold, silver, and bronze medals.
Q: How is watch time calculated?\nA: It sums up the runtime of every movie and episode you watched, displayed in hours.
Q: What are rating statistics?\nA: Shows your total number of ratings, average rating, and rating distribution on Trakt. Only rated titles are counted.
